text: Strings shall be double-quoted and admit JSON escapes for quote, backslash, slash, backspace, form feed, newline, carriage return, tab, and four-hex-digit Unicode escapes. Raw controls/newlines, invalid escapes, and isolated surrogate escapes shall be rejected; adjacent escaped surrogate pairs shall decode to one scalar.
